channel.title: South Sudan - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from South Sudan, every source cited.

item.title: UK gives South Sudan $2.8 million for flood preparedness
item.description: Funding will support early flood preparedness and response activities in Jonglei, Unity and Upper Nile states.

item.title: Renk depot explosions injure civilians and soldiers
item.description: South Sudan's army blames high temperatures for blasts at ammunition depots in Upper Nile State.

item.title: South Sudan seeks Russian investment in key sectors
item.description: President Salva Kiir invited Russian investors to develop agriculture, oil, mining, and tourism during the Russia-Africa Summit.

item.title: South Sudan police arrest two drivers after pedestrian death
item.description: Two drivers are in custody following a fatal accident on the Juba-Nimule highway, with investigations ongoing.

item.title: South Sudanese children demand climate action
item.description: Young participants adopted a declaration in Juba calling for climate-resilient schools and early warning systems.
